notes.title: Christmas Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! It's your devs here!

The Christmas and New Year season has always been something special. The frost that chills you to the bone, the snow blanketing everything outside and keeping you indoors, and of course, the endless dark nights (a special bonus for those of us living in northern regions, like we do). But this year, most of those magical experiences (except the nights) decided to skip us entirely: it's +4°C outside, the snow forecast has turned into rain, and the holiday vibes are a bit harder to catch. So how do you get into the festive spirit? Well, how about enjoying your favorite game!

And to become one of those favorite games, we've prepared an update that’s coming very soon (hopefully before 2025)! And no, it’s not just a Santa hat for Roshan!

This update will have text, pictures, and… well, something else we can't quite remember!

Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year (just in case we don't make it in time)!

With love,
COMAN & ELIANA

notes.title: First-day patch (0c)
notes.notes:
During the first day, thanks to player feedback, we identified and fixed several bugs.


 Fixed the error "name 'let_go_lux_in_chapter_four' is not defined," which affected some players.
 Fixed the error that prevented starting Chapter 5 in an alternative way (under certain playthrough conditions).
 Corrected several typos.


We have already released patches for all these issues and tested the game's functionality and achievement unlocks. Everything should be working now.

Please continue to report any new issues, and we'll fix them as quickly as possible!

notes.title: Announcement of update 0.05.8.0
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! The Second Chance developers are back in touch!
We're here, which means we have some amazing news!

Nothing terrible has happened to us since the last announcement (hooray!), so we're happy to tell you a bit more about the upcoming update. And believe us, it was worth the wait!

Ready? Hold on tight, because here's what's in store for you:

- Over 20,000 lines of new code! Yes, you heard that right. This includes new dialogues and a full translation into English. Our fingers are still smoking!
- A new HCG gallery with more than 90 images. Our sole artist has been working tirelessly (with graphics tablets in hand).
- Several new locations with their own atmospheric backgrounds. Get ready to explore!
- Four new characters with fresh sprites and a few old acquaintances who have finally emerged from the folders of our computers.
- And of course, a bunch of new achievements! Because who doesn't love achievements, right?

But that's not all! The fresh update will allow you to continue Lin's story right from where it left off earlier. And trust us, the mysteries surrounding her are thickening like never before. Will Lin be able to overcome this seemingly insurmountable force? It depends only on you and your actions!

Oh, and we almost forgot! We've hidden some interesting tidbits that will shed light on past events. Get ready to look at some things that previously seemed obvious in a new way...

And now for the most important part - the release date! Drum roll... The update will be out on Thursday, August 8, 2024!

We can't wait for you to dive into new adventures. Thank you for staying with us!

notes.title: Preview of update 0.05.8.0
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! It's the Second Chance game developers here!
What? You thought we abandoned the game? Pffft! Of course not!

Two years ago, when we released a small update, we had no idea how much our lives would change in the near future. Back then, we planned to release the next story update in just a couple of months - summer 2022. But, as you noticed, that didn’t happen.

Over these two years, a lot has changed, and many things have happened. We had to leave our home and start from scratch in a new country. These were very challenging times. Nevertheless, the game development never stopped. We kept writing text, fixing code, creating new art, and designing future updates. Unfortunately, the work wasn't as regular as we would have liked, so we couldn’t frequently share news about new content with you. However, we did share some updates about our progress on our Patreon and Boosty.

But enough time has passed, and now we're ready to announce that we’ve prepared the update that should have come out two years ago!

This time, the story of Lynn will continue. Along the way, we'll meet new characters who might have a big impact on our destiny. Additionally, some old characters will reappear in a slightly different light. But most importantly, we will influence Lynn's fate.

We'll tell you more about the upcoming update very soon!

A huge thanks to everyone who supports us on Patreon and Boosty. Thanks to you, we can still keep working on the project!

notes.title: June, 2nd (Update)
notes.notes:
In today's update, we continued work on Chapter Five. As we have written before, the fifth chapter will be added in parts. Today we have added another part to Chapter 5, so we have raised the version of the game to 0.05.2.2... For now, that part is only available when you go through Jace's storyline in Chapter Four.

So, in today's update:

 Added the option to help Seraz in chapter five
 Added another mini-game with a fight.
 Added English translation for all new content
 Added 5 achievements related to new content.
 Reworked the game launch sequence.
 The content warning and age verification screens have been completely rewritten to prevent rare errors with the inability to start playing on some builds of Unix systems.
 The credits have been updated as of 1 June 2020. If you supported the game on Patreon from January 2020 to June 2020, you can now find your name in the credits.
 Fixed typos in both Russian and English versions.
 Added new errors and typos.


It took us quite a while to create this relatively small update, so it is possible that some details may have been lost in time. That being the case, we can say that this is probably not a complete list of changes.

Now that the problems are slowly but surely receding, we hope to be able to release updates more often.

Thank you so much for staying with us!
With love,
COMAN & ELIANA

notes.title: Release date changing
notes.notes:
As many know, the release of our Steam game was scheduled for November 16th. It is now November 16th, but still it’s impossible to install the game in Steam, and you’re probably tormented by the question - what the hell? Perhaps, in order not to torment you with expectations, we will give an answer to it.

Initially, we planned that the release of the game will take place on November 16th. This date was not chosen by chance, since some of the content was not ready at the time of the announcement. We expected that before this date we would have time to bring all the missing content into the game and correct errors during beta testing. However, we did not take into account some factors that may affect the release date. It was the Steam factor.

The fact is that before publishing the game has to pass some testing from Steam (we are talking directly about the game's client). Normally, this check takes 2-3 days, but in some cases the check can take up to 5 days. Since our client was fully operational, there were no microtransactions and external servers in the game, we expected that the game check would not be delayed. When the 5th day of testing went, it became obvious that everything would not be so simple. After 5 days we received a response and a list of errors that need to be corrected. The peculiarity of the check lies in the fact that the estimated release date also shifted by another 5 days.

When checking a client, there are common and critical errors. Common errors, which are optional to fix and do not affect the possibility of release. Critical errors are errors that do not allow the game to appear in Steam until they are fixed.

The common mistakes were, in particular, the fact that the client was universal for Linux, Windows and MacOS, and not separately. In addition, incomplete English localization was noted and the absence of a pause when calling the Steam overlay.

There were only two critical errors. The first is the presence of the Patreon button in the game, which leads to our page on the Patreon. The second is the inaccuracy in the description of early access, made when translating into English.

Realizing that the re-test will last another 5 days, we focused on correcting critical errors as soon as possible. And even if we had to shed some tears to remove the patreon button, since Patreon is the only source of funding for the development of this game, we did manage. After that, the client was sent for re-verification.

This time the result of the check did not make us wait and came only on the third day. It would seem - we fixed two critical errors and did not create a single new one! After all, this should mean that the game is allowed to release, right? Wrong. The error associated with incomplete English localization, suddenly from the common became into critical. And, as follows from what was described earlier, this postpones the release of the game for another 5 days. Now the nearest possible date is listed as November 21, 2018. However, it is worth bearing in mind that the translation is not yet complete, and, therefore, we cannot promise that the game will be released by this date.

So far, we have changed the release date to November 22. But this date may not be final, if Steam suddenly finds any more errors, or translates olded errors from common into the critical section.
